name: kren-translate
description: Selection-first dictionaries, offline English grammar checking, translation, nuance explanation, multilingual rewriting, and read aloud inside VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Dictionaries, grammar checking, translation, explanation, rewriting, and Local Windows speech remain available. Edge Online speech is disabled because it launches a configured Python executable.

virtualWorkspaces.description: KREN is designed for a local VS Code Desktop extension host.

commands.title: Set Google Cloud Translation API Key
Delete Google Cloud Translation API Key

languageModelTools.name: kren_lookupEnglishDictionary
languageModelTools.userDescription: Look up an English word or short expression with Merriam-Webster.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Look up an English word or short multi-word expression in Merriam-Webster Collegiate. For a multi-word expression only, Google Cloud Translation is used when Merriam-Webster returns no entry. Use this for authoritative English dictionary definitions, not general translation.

text.description: The exact English word or short expression to look up. No surrounding document context.

languageModelTools.name: kren_lookupKoreanDictionary
languageModelTools.userDescription: Look up a Korean word with the Korean Basic Dictionary.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Look up one Korean headword in the Korean Basic Dictionary and return its English dictionary entry. Use only for Korean single-word dictionary lookup.

text.description: The exact Korean word to look up.

languageModelTools.name: kren_lookupMedicalDictionary
languageModelTools.userDescription: Look up an English medical term with Merriam-Webster Medical Dictionary.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Look up one English medical term in Merriam-Webster Medical Dictionary. Use for dictionary definitions and terminology, not diagnosis or medical advice.

text.description: The exact English medical term to look up.

languageModelTools.name: kren_searchSynonyms
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find synonyms and related word groups with Merriam-Webster Collegiate Thesaurus.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search Merriam-Webster Collegiate Thesaurus for the explicit English word or short expression. Returns synonyms by sense plus available near synonyms, related words, phrases, antonyms, and near antonyms.

text.description: The exact English word or short expression whose synonyms should be searched.

languageModelTools.name: kren_translateText
languageModelTools.userDescription: Translate explicitly supplied text with the configured KREN provider.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Translate only the explicit text argument with KREN's configured Google Cloud Translation or Gemini provider. The default auto-en-ko target sends English to Korean and Korean to English; an explicit target language overrides it. Do not add editor, file, workspace, or chat context to the text argument.

text.description: Only the exact text the user wants translated.

targetLanguage.description: Optional ISO/BCP-47 output language code or auto-en-ko; otherwise the KREN setting is used.

languageModelTools.name: kren_explainText
languageModelTools.userDescription: Explain the meaning, nuance, register, or connotation of explicitly supplied text.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use KREN's configured Gemini, OpenAI API, or Anthropic Claude API provider to explain meaning, nuance, register, connotation, ambiguity, and technical usage for only the explicit text argument. Do not add editor, file, workspace, or chat context.

text.description: Only the exact text whose meaning or nuance should be explained.

outputLanguage.description: Optional ISO/BCP-47 explanation language code, or bilingual for English and Korean.

kren.userDictionary.enabled.description: Enable the local User Dictionary commands and interface. No provider request or local entry write is possible while disabled.

enumDescriptions: Generate an editable draft with the selected language-model provider.
Run an independent live Merriam-Webster lookup and language-model generation.
kren.userDictionary.defaultCaptureMode.description: Capture mode used by Add to User Dictionary.

kren.userDictionary.fallbackOnMerriamWeb.description: Show the independent LLM-only draft after Merriam-Webster returns a genuine no-match. Authentication, quota, network, and provider failures never trigger this fallback.

enumDescriptions: Use the Gemini Developer API and the existing default Gemini credential.
Use the OpenAI API and the existing OpenAI credential.
Use the Anthropic Claude API and the existing Anthropic credential.
kren.userDictionary.provider.description: Dedicated language-model provider for User Dictionary generation.

kren.userDictionary.model.description: Editable model identifier used only for User Dictionary generation.

kren.userDictionary.thinkingOrEffort.description: Thinking level or effort sent when supported by the selected User Dictionary provider and model.

kren.userDictionary.entryLanguage.description: Use auto to detect the expression language, or enter a BCP-47 language tag for saved entries.

kren.userDictionary.includeSynonyms.description: Request synonyms, antonyms, and related expressions.

kren.userDictionary.includeUsageNotes.description: Request short usage notes when they prevent misunderstanding.

kren.userDictionary.numberOfExamples.description: Maximum number of generated examples retained for each sense.

kren.userDictionary.maxImportEntries.description: Maximum number of entries accepted from a single User Dictionary import. A larger file is refused with its entry count rather than accepted slowly.

kren.userDictionary.includeTechnicalMean.description: Request established technical meanings when genuinely applicable.

kren.results.openAtStartup.description: Open the KREN Secondary Sidebar after VS Code finishes starting. Off by default; enabling creates the KREN webview at startup.

enumDescriptions: Use standard Google Cloud Translation NMT with your own API key and KREN's hard local monthly limit.
Use the Gemini Developer API with your own key.
kren.translationProvider.description: Provider used by Translate Selection. Dictionary commands use Merriam-Webster for English and KBD for Korean.

kren.translation.targetLanguage.description: Translation target. auto-en-ko sends English to Korean and Korean to English. Enter an ISO/BCP-47 output code for a fixed target, or use KREN: Configure Translation and Explanation Languages.

enumDescriptions: Check American English spelling and grammar.
Check British English spelling and grammar.
Check Australian English spelling and grammar.
Check Canadian English spelling and grammar.
Check Indian English spelling and grammar.
kren.grammar.dialect.description: English dialect used by the offline Harper Grammar Check. Selected text never leaves this computer.

kren.grammar.autoCheck.description: After typing pauses, check only the current paragraph with local Harper. Off by default; no text is sent over the network.

kren.grammar.autoCheckDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before optional automatic current-paragraph grammar checking.

kren.explanation.outputLanguage.description: ISO/BCP-47 output language code used by Explain Meaning or Nuance, or bilingual for English and Korean. Use the KREN language configuration command for a searchable selector.

enumDescriptions: Use the Gemini Developer API.
Use the OpenAI API. API charges may apply.
Use the Anthropic Claude API. API charges may apply.
kren.explanation.provider.description: Language-model provider used by Explain Meaning or Nuance. KREN never silently falls back to a different provider.

enumDescriptions: Use the user-supplied default Gemini key and kren.gemini.model.
Use the optional user-supplied alternate Gemini key and kren.gemini.alternateModel.
kren.explanation.geminiProfile.description: Gemini credential and model profile used by Explain Meaning or Nuance.

enumDescriptions: Use the selected default or alternate Gemini profile.
Use the OpenAI API. API charges may apply.
Use the Anthropic Claude API. API charges may apply.
kren.rewrite.provider.description: Language-model provider used by Rewrite Text. KREN never silently falls back to a different provider.

kren.openai.model.description: Editable OpenAI model ID used for explanation and rewriting when OpenAI is selected.

kren.openai.reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort sent to compatible OpenAI models.

kren.anthropic.model.description: Editable Anthropic model ID used for explanation and rewriting when Anthropic is selected.

kren.anthropic.effort.description: Effort sent to compatible Anthropic models.

kren.languageModel.retry.enabled.description: Retry transient OpenAI and Anthropic failures with the same selected provider.

kren.languageModel.retry.maxAttempts.description: Maximum OpenAI or Anthropic attempts, including the initial request.

kren.gemini.model.description: Gemini model ID. Availability, access, quotas, pricing, and permitted use depend on the user's Google project and region.

kren.gemini.thinkingLevel.description: Thinking level for the default Gemini profile. Auto selects a compatible level for the configured model.

kren.gemini.retry.enabled.description: Automatically retry transient Gemini failures such as 408, 429, 500, 502, 503, and 504.

kren.gemini.retry.maxAttempts.description: Maximum Gemini attempts, including the initial request. Retries use exponential backoff and honor Retry-After.

enumDescriptions: Use the user-supplied default Gemini key and kren.gemini.model.
Use the optional user-supplied alternate Gemini key and kren.gemini.alternateModel.
kren.rewrite.geminiProfile.description: Gemini credential and model profile used by Rewrite Text.

kren.gemini.alternateModel.description: Model used by the alternate Gemini profile for Explain Meaning or Nuance and Rewrite Text. The KREN settings interface provides editable discovered suggestions.

kren.gemini.alternateFallbackEnabled.description: For Explain Meaning or Nuance and Rewrite Text, use the configured same-provider fallback when the alternate model is unavailable, remains temporarily unavailable, or returns unusable structured output. Fallback use is identified in the result.

kren.rewrite.sourceLanguage.description: Source language for Rewrite Text. Use auto to detect and preserve the selected text's language, or enter a BCP-47 code such as en, ko, ja, or es. English-variety settings apply only to English.

kren.gemini.alternateFallbackModel.description: Fallback model for the alternate Gemini profile in Explain Meaning or Nuance and Rewrite Text.

enumDescriptions: Let KREN choose a compatible level for the fallback model.
Minimize fallback latency where the model supports it.
Use low thinking for routine explanation and rewriting.
Use balanced additional reasoning.
Use maximum reasoning depth, latency, and potential cost.
kren.gemini.alternateFallbackThinkingLev.description: Thinking level used independently by the alternate Gemini fallback model.

enumDescriptions: Lowest latency and thinking-token cost; recommended for rewriting.
Balanced additional reasoning, latency, and cost.
Maximum reasoning depth, latency, and potential cost.
kren.gemini.alternateThinkingLevel.description: Thinking level used by the alternate Gemini profile for explanation and rewriting. Model support varies by the configured model.

enumDescriptions: Show Natural first.
Show the Concise rewrite first.
Show the Jargon-Free rewrite first.
kren.rewrite.preferredVariant.description: Rewrite variant selected initially in the rich KREN panel. All returned variants remain available as tabs.

enumDescriptions: Place the all-three-variants action first in the KREN clipboard Quick Pick.
Place Natural first in the KREN clipboard Quick Pick.
Place Concise first in the KREN clipboard Quick Pick.
Place Jargon-Free first in the KREN clipboard Quick Pick.
kren.rewrite.quickMenuVariant.description: Preferred Rewrite Text action in the KREN clipboard Quick Pick. All four rewrite choices remain available.

enumDescriptions: Write text for reading on a page or screen.
Write text for spoken delivery and suppress formatting preservation.
kren.rewrite.modality.description: Destination modality applied to Rewrite Text requests.

enumDescriptions: Preserve a general-purpose document function.
Use wording suitable for a proposal.
Use wording suitable for a manuscript.
Use wording suitable for a report.
Use wording suitable for a presentation.
Use wording suitable for a letter without inventing letter furniture.
Use wording suitable for an email without inventing greetings or sign-offs.
kren.rewrite.function.description: Document or channel function applied to Rewrite Text requests.

enumDescriptions: General-purpose English without a specialized domain style.
Clear professional business prose focused on actions and decisions.
Disciplined academic prose with appropriate qualification and terminology.
Precise scientific prose that preserves units and evidentiary qualifications.
Precise technical prose that preserves necessary specialist terminology.
Precise regulatory prose that preserves defined terms and obligations.
Precise medical prose that preserves clinical qualifications and terminology.
Precise legal prose that preserves defined terms, qualifications, and legal effect.
kren.rewrite.domain.description: Domain preset applied to Rewrite Text requests.

enumDescriptions: Use the English dialect selected under Grammar Check.
Use standard American English.
Use standard British English.
Use standard Australian English.
Use standard Canadian English.
Use standard Indian English.
Use internationally accessible, region-neutral English.
kren.rewrite.englishVariety.description: English spelling, punctuation, vocabulary, idiom, and usage applied only when Rewrite Text detects or is assigned English.

enumDescriptions: Preserve the source's level of formality.
Use ceremonial, dignified formality without becoming archaic.
Use formal, precise wording without becoming ornate.
Use a neutral, natural level of formality.
Use natural informal wording without invented familiarity.
Use relaxed, conversational wording without becoming careless.
kren.rewrite.formality.description: Formality applied to Rewrite Text requests.

enumDescriptions: Preserve the writer's recognizable voice.
Use an authoritative voice without inventing authority.
Use an objective voice that preserves uncertainty.
Use an analytical voice without adding analysis or evidence.
Use an instructional voice without inventing steps.
kren.rewrite.voice.description: Rhetorical voice applied to Rewrite Text requests.

enumDescriptions: Preserve the source's interpersonal stance.
Use a neutral interpersonal stance.
Use an approachable and respectful stance without invented familiarity.
State the message tactfully and constructively.
Use careful qualifications and avoid unsupported certainty.
Use confident wording without strengthening claims or certainty.
State the point clearly and economically without becoming abrupt.
kren.rewrite.stance.description: Interpersonal stance applied to Rewrite Text requests.

enumDescriptions: Preserve the source's level of detail.
Make every rewrite shorter while retaining every important point.
Make every rewrite longer using only supplied information.
kren.rewrite.length.description: Length constraint applied to the finished Rewrite Text output.

enumDescriptions: Preserve the source's perspective.
Use first-person perspective without inventing experience or authority.
Use impersonal perspective while preserving meaningful agency.
kren.rewrite.perspective.description: Perspective applied to Rewrite Text requests.

enumDescriptions: Preserve the source's original communicative intent.
Make the supplied point easier to understand without inventing context.
Organize the supplied claims persuasively without adding evidence or urgency.
Frame the supplied position as a clear recommendation without inventing reasons or obligations.
Express the supplied concern or disagreement clearly and respectfully.
kren.rewrite.rhetoricalMode.description: Rhetorical goal applied to Rewrite Text requests.

kren.rewrite.preserveFormatting.description: Tell the selected rewrite provider to preserve Markdown, LaTeX, citations, links, placeholders, filenames, and code while rewriting.

kren.rewrite.includeChangeNotes.description: Ask the selected rewrite provider to include one concise explanation of the important edits for each rewrite variant.

kren.rewrite.tts.enabled.description: Show explicit Read Aloud and Stop controls for rewrite variants using KREN's shared speech source, voice, speed, and volume.

kren.readAloud.voice.description: Installed Windows System.Speech voice used by the editor Read Aloud command. Leave empty to use the Windows default voice.

kren.readAloud.rate.description: Windows Read Aloud speech rate. Zero is the normal voice rate.

kren.readAloud.volume.description: Shared Read Aloud playback volume for Local Windows and Edge Online speech.

enumDescriptions: Use an installed offline Windows System.Speech voice. Selected text never leaves the PC.
Use an experimental Microsoft Edge online neural voice through edge-tts. Only the cleaned selected text is sent to Microsoft.
kren.readAloud.provider.description: Shared speech source for editor selections, rewrite variants, and voice preview.

kren.readAloud.edgeVoice.description: Editable Microsoft Edge online voice ID. The KREN panel visibly offers Christopher Natural and Ava Natural presets.

kren.readAloud.edgeRatePercent.description: Microsoft Edge online voice speed adjustment. Zero percent is the natural speed.

kren.readAloud.edgePythonCommand.description: Python interpreter containing the optional edge-tts package. Install it with: python -m pip install edge-tts

kren.dictionary.multiWordTranslationFall.description: Use Google Cloud Translation when Merriam-Webster has no entry for a multi-word English expression.

kren.pronunciation.windowsNativePlayback.description: On a local Windows extension host, download validated Merriam-Webster pronunciation audio to a bounded temporary file and play it through a hidden native PowerShell/WPF process. No application window opens. Failures fall back to the KREN webview player.

kren.display.mode.description: Where an immediate result is displayed.

kren.translation.maxCharacters.description: Maximum number of selected characters sent to a provider.
